messages:
maddie (AE): FYI — Orion Labs execs want a 48h unblock to sign off the POC. Procurement paused us over SSO and egress. Can we triage? :alarm_clock:
raj (Solutions Eng): Copy — what exactly did procurement ask for on egress? ip allowlist / data residency / audit logs?
maddie (AE): They want a clear egress diagram, list of third-party endpoints, and a lock on where logs land. Also asked if we support their BYO-KMS flow.
sophie (Security): I can draft the egress diagram + answers for the security questionnaire. Need the list of model endpoints we're exposing. @raj can you paste the service URLs?
raj (Solutions Eng): quick list: api.redwood-hosted.com (text gen), embed.redwood-hosted.com (embeddings), s3-upload.redwood-hosted.com (artifact store). Will confirm on BYO-KMS compatibility — we support customer KMS via our private deployment; for hosted we'll need an addendum.
juan (Infra): For SSO they want SAML metadata + ACS URLs. Pasting minimal SAML config: `entityID: https://console.redwood.ai/saml`, `acs: https://console.redwood.ai/saml/consume`. Also note IP ranges: 34.120.0.0/14, 35.192.0.0/12 (will provide CIDR doc).
alec (Sales Lead): We need a single slide for the VP that covers: timeline (48h), ask (legal + infra confirmation), and discount ask (they want enterprise trial credits + a contract-level 20% discount if signed in 2 weeks). Who owns pricing confirmation?
maddie (AE): @alec I'll own communicating the discount, but need finance signoff for the 20%. @legal-bot can you confirm if we already have a standard hosted DPA + BYO-KMS addendum template?
legal-bot: Automated note: DPA template v2.1 and BYO-KMS addendum v1.0 available in /legal/templates. For custom legal redlines, please open a ticket and tag @legal-team.
sophie (Security): I'll assemble the questionnaire answers by EOD and attach the egress CIDRs + SAML sample. If procurement insists on on-prem, we can propose a Private trial but that adds lead time.
raj (Solutions Eng): Quick technical note: to avoid perf regressions during POC set model to `redwood-2-small` and enable prefix cache; that reduces token cost and keeps latency within their SLA.
juan (Infra): I'll generate the CIDR list and a short network diagram PNG in the next 3 hours.
alec (Sales Lead): Meeting with Orion VP scheduled tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need the one-pager before then. Maddie, Raj, Sophie — can we have slide + bullets by 9:30 PT?
maddie (AE): On it. I'll compile slides and ping legal if we need any contract tweaks.
sophie (Security): :thumbsup: I'll drop the questionnaire answers into the thread when ready.
raj (Solutions Eng): If they request egress-only allowlist, we can provide per-environment IPs — note that for hosted bursts we recommend FQDN allowlist coupled with short-lived certificates.
maddie (AE): Thanks everyone. Action items: Sophie — security Qs + egress CIDRs; Juan — SAML + diagram; Raj — endpoint list + model recommendation; Alec — pricing confirmation with finance. I'll post the slide deck here by 09:15 PT for review. :hourglass:
